messages.subject: Lambert W function in RTMB
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

First, apologies. Is there a RTMB equivalent mailing list that I should be using? Or somewhere else I should post RTMB questions?

The question:
Does anyone know if RTMB has a native lambertW function that I could use?  something similar to the gsl::lambert_W0() in R.

I want to use it to estimate the semelparous reference points described in:

Scheuerell MD. 2016. An explicit solution for calculating optimum spawning stock size from Ricker’s stock recruitment model. PeerJ 4:e1623 https://doi.org/10.7717/peerj.1623

Thanks,

Catarina

messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for the quick response. Having a lambertW built-in in RTMB would be great for those of us doing Pacific salmon stock assessment. But the example you sent is working great.

Also, I noticed that the lambertW in the example is not defined for negative values, which may be useful in some instances. For now we adapted the code from the lamW package <https://github.com/cran/lamW/blob/master/src/lambertW.cpp>, which is defined over a broader range.  Just another request to keep in mind in case you decide to add built-in functions.

thanks again!

Catarina
